title: Systems that hold their shape under real constraints
body: Most of what makes a product hard is not the feature list. It is permissions, migrations, partial failure, and the second environment. I design for those first, because retrofitting them means rewriting the parts that were fun to build.

title: Retrieval that can show its work
body: A language model is only as trustworthy as the passages behind it. I build retrieval that carries citations through to the answer, refuses when nothing is relevant, and can be replayed against a fixed question set to see what actually changed.

title: Interfaces that stay usable at the edges
body: Keyboard paths, focus order, contrast, and behaviour at 320 pixels are not a pass at the end. They are part of whether the thing works, so they get decided while the component is being written rather than audited after it ships.
